cc:Work.dc:description: Vectors a=[1,2,0] and b=[2,4,0] share a direction; c=[0,1,2] differs. Dot products are 10 and 2. The distance between a and b is square root of 5. Cosine scores are 1 and 0.4. Geometry is preserved in a two-dimensional drawing.
